notes.title: Update after one year
notes.notes:
Dear All,
I am Mr.H, after I first released the game years ago, I got lots of suggest and comment. Since I am not familiar to use RMMV, I change to learn to use Unity.
At the same time, I update the UI icon and delete the maze. Since I am still learning, the changing of language need to uninstall and install in steam. Also the Steam achievement are not used now.
Sorry that while I start to work and don't have much time to update the game. The screenshot the movie are still in old version.
Finally, my new game "金斧偶像金小萱GoldenAxeIdol" are making and the store page are opened.
Hope I can make a better game to everyone.
Best regard.

notes.title: Exclude English version on store page
notes.notes: Sorry for all the users playing in English version. For the feedback, the quality of translation isn't really well. It is not only because the words of oriental is hard to translate to English but also the author's English ability isn't good enough. So I will back to change for new version. I will just exclude the English version on the store page. But still can play the old version if you buy it. Thanks for any feedback on the costumer review or through"Visit the website". Thanks a lot.
